content.comment_body: Hello, I developed a program using [product_name] [version_no]. I'm encountering a problem with an analog signal (0-10V). The analog signal is connected to the second controller (slave using UTP), but I want to use the signal on the first controller (master). Can anyone advise on the correct method to achieve this? We use a light sensor to control some lighting. I hope someone can provide assistance. Greetings from the Netherlands, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], I wasn't able to fully understand your question from the image. Please attach your [product_name] program here by making it a ZIP file so it can be posted. Regards,
Hello, Here is the program I'm referring to.

Hello [user_name], It's not possible to directly access analog values over the network. You need to set up variable mapping for each analog address. 1. Assign different IP addresses for server and client. 2. Right-click on the Ethernet connection and select 'Add Connection'. 3. Choose the connection type (server or client). 4. Under data transfer, in the ID column, select 'Read' if you intend to read the analog output from another device. In the Data Length column, set to 2 for word-length data. In the Address column (local and remote), input the relevant addresses (e.g., VB2). 5. Go to Tools > VM Mapping, select the block, and type the address so it matches the data transfer address as specified in step 4. A simple reference program is attached for your review. Regards,
Hello, I still don't understand how to program this. Can someone explain the process more clearly? Greetings from the Netherlands, [user_name]
